CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates by Tuxxler, the maker of the **NASlab** Android app (NAS and home-server companion for Unraid, TrueNAS, Synology and Linux).
Currently one app: **NASlab-Agent**, a small read-only monitoring container for the NASlab app. It measures temperatures, CPU, GPU, RAM, network, disk spin-ups and keeps a file index of your shares. It never changes anything on your server: all host paths are mounted read-only, only `/config` is writable, root is dropped after start.
The agent is free. It is open source (GNU AGPL-3.0-only): https://github.com/Tuxxler/nzblab-agent . The templates in this repository are MIT. The NASlab app itself is a separate, closed-source Android app on Google Play.
Support, questions and bug reports: GitHub issues in the agent repository (linked below).
